In this solo episode I'm breaking down a business model where people white-label GoHighLevel and resell the software to specific local businesses. I reverse engineer companies serving event rentals, med spas, gyms, dentists, and roofers to see what they charge, how they get customers, and what their businesses could be making. I also walk through tools like the Meta Ads Library, Wayback Machine, BuiltWith, and LinkedIn to show how you can research these businesses yourself. Finally, I build a simple missed-call text-back system for roofers from scratch to show just how quickly you could turn one of these ideas into a real service.

Enjoy!
